title: socket.connect raises ConnectionError when dragging a file into a record
body:
Environment

Running Lattice 3.1.5 on Windows Server 2022 against us-
east-1.

Steps

Steps to reproduce:
- With the log window open, start dragging a file into a
  record.
- Generate load with the stress script and watch the
  connection gauge.
- Wait for the failure and read the log.

Expected

Expected dragging a file into a record to finish without
errors.

Actual

Connections start failing after a few hundred calls and
recover only after a restart. Under load the open-connection
gauge climbs steadily and never comes back down.

Frequency

Reproduces roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/ui/upload.py:39 in on_drop
lattice/io/upload.py:115 in send
lattice/net/socket.py:75 in connect
ConnectionError: connection refused (host=us-east-1)
